title: Diameter Symbol: Copy & Paste ⌀ Engineering Diameter Sign
meta_description: Copy and paste the diameter symbol (⌀) used in engineering drawings and machining specs, plus its confusable neighbors Ø and ∅. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: The diameter sign (⌀) that precedes circular dimensions on engineering drawings — plus the symbols people mistake for it. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The diameter symbol (⌀, Unicode U+2300) is the circle-with-a-slash mark that goes in front of a measurement to say "this is a diameter, not a radius." It shows up on machining specs, CAD drawings, and manufacturing callouts — and it's routinely swapped for lookalike characters that mean something else entirely.
